methodology: Manual source and trust-boundary review of the full requested scope
Local rg discovery of HTML/code execution sinks, dynamic URLs, credential persistence, browser requests and worker dispatch
Trace URL/query/fragment, API strings, uploaded filenames and localStorage values to their consumers

manual_review.conclusion: No exploitable vulnerability was confirmed in the reviewed frontend source. This is not a whole-system or production certification.

reviewed_surfaces.result: React text rendering and Leaflet popup DOM node/textContent; no dangerous HTML/code execution sinks found
Login destination constrained to local paths; public inputs encoded; external catalog source link constrained by server contract and noreferrer
Same-origin credentialed API helper with CSRF; API secret shown in transient component state; only language in localStorage; no JS cookie access or fixed private credentials found
Fragment read in memory and exchanged through POST; no automatic consumption on page render
GPS requires explicit action; images sent to server validation; filenames rendered as text; owned JSON exported via revocable Blob URL
Client role gate is presentational; privileged mutations use server endpoints, not client-derived authorization
ASSETS binding only; GET/HEAD HTML fallback to fixed index path with cleared query; no arbitrary upstream or secret egress

final_delta: Relations and QR URLs use fixed local routes and encoded public codes; React escapes all aliases and review text.
Source/version and withdrawal forms use the shared CSRF API helper; authorization, immutable hierarchy, ownership and atomic version checks remain on the server.
Review FormData is transient; no GPS/private evidence persisted to browser storage.
Controlled Escape handler prevents native close from bypassing a caller that keeps a pending submission open.
styles.css: removed one trailing empty line after verification; no selector or declaration changed.
Gate preserves the local query for corrections without copying fragment tokens; validNext still constrains the login destination.
Correction payloads retain their target and update_existing intent after changes_requested; API rejects target changes and canonicalizes an omitted code.
Leaflet zoomAnimation uses the public false option to prevent a pending transition callback after remove(); zoom and navigation remain usable.

semgrep.app_agent_tokens: No app authentication or upload was used; local rules, metrics off and version checks disabled

setup_attempts.cause: No space left on device in the /tmp tmpfs

triage_groups.reason: The app uses its own translator; all literal keys have ES/FR/HT values verified by Node tests.
Reviewed static brands, API identifiers and formats. No executable HTML sink.
All ten distinct sites reviewed: queryString object interpolation or an intentional curl/JSON example; duplicate rule matches.
All six spreads originate from application code/state, not untrusted API attribute objects.
TerritoryForm intentionally initializes the editable level from its selected territory. Dialog is keyed by territory ID and is closed on reload/save; no security boundary relies on this state.

semgrep.installation: Official PyPI semgrep 1.185.0 in a dedicated WSL venv; no paid service or code upload

limitations: Sites worker is static-only and contains no API proxy or security-header policy; deployment routing and headers require host-level verification
External map tile requests disclose viewport area and client IP to the selected provider; pilot privacy/provider terms remain an operational decision
No browser penetration testing, fuzzing, provider integration or remote hosting verification was performed in this scoped task
Manual review and OSS rule coverage do not prove absence of vulnerabilities or verify backend authorization and production cookies
Current integration passed 16 Node tests, a production build and 8 isolated browser tests; physical GPS and remote hosting remain unverified
